scope: Source and typed handoff only; no live semantic execution or training admission
source_findings: The reader separates theory and prior convention inventory from one complete joint-ticket interpretation per original ticket ID; it does not infer posterior selection during reading.
The finite frontier consumes one pending unit per step and preserves completed accepted, unresolved, and failed results, so a later defective ticket cannot erase prior successes.
The scoped literal owns ticket-specific theory, correlated assignments and positive joint mass; the parent binds exact clause witnesses and retains the actual returned tuple.
The reader checks original ID coverage exactly once and carries unresolved evidence forward without treating missing data as a zero-mass world.
The host types and named callable signatures agree; complete tickets flow to reconstructBelief through TheoryIndex.
